title: 第八十章 四君登庭呈冤状 玉帝封正定诸天第七十九章 玉盘自动归四主 灵山万载大计空

第八十章四君登庭呈冤状玉帝封正定诸天
大唐长安，天光大朗，瑞气盈霄。
自苍生玉盘挣脱佛门禁锢、破空东归、认主归宗之后，三界气机彻底翻覆。
西土灵山佛运崩塌、金辉黯淡、金莲凋零、禅音萎靡；
东土人间正道昭彰、山河清晏、疫毒尽绝、万民归心。
一场延续万古的仙佛博弈、至宝纷争、正邪拉锯，终以灵山大败、伪梦成空、正道重光落幕。
四君立身皇城云海，头顶玉盘轮转清辉，周身苍生道韵圆满无缺。道基修复、本源归位、执念澄明、功德满身。
宁洋北抬眸望三十三天凌霄宝殿方向，道音沉稳：“灵山逆天乱道、夺宝囚神、构陷忠良、祸乱苍生、欺天罔地、私改天命，罪证累累、业债滔天。
昔日我等蒙冤被困、身落人手、有状难申、有冤难雪；
如今至宝归宗、正道重明、人心归正、天道清明，
正是登庭鸣冤、上表诸天、状告灵山、请断天刑之时！”
张忠东正色道：“伪佛万年布局，以权谋乱天道，以霸道窃苍生，以慈悲掩祸心，以圣威压公义。
此番若不诸天立案、天庭审判、定其罪业、明其过失，
则天道无章、天规无用、正邪无别、万古难平！”
王学南拱手道：“我四人非为私怨争荣辱，只为天道讨公权！
不求天庭降杀伐、不求三界灭灵山，
只求罪者定罪、冤者雪冤、逆者受罚、正者受封，
令三界万世皆知：天道有序、公道不亡、逆道必惩、守道必昌！”
陈学西刀意敛于眼底，声如金石：“今日登庭，一则申万古奇冤，二则呈佛门重罪，三则复苍生正统，四则定三界将来格局！”
四君心意合一、道韵同频、正气冲天。

当下辞别唐太宗君臣。
李世民率文武百官立于丹陛，拱手躬身，恭敬相送：
“四位圣君此去天庭申冤，必能天道昭雪、正法长存！
朕率大唐万民，静待诸天公道、静待圣君荣封！”
四君微微颔首，足踏祥云、身起长风，四道浩然道影直冲九霄，穿云海、破罡风、过星阙、直抵三十三天凌霄宝殿之外。
彼时天庭早已异象万千、诸天震动。
玉盘归宗、正道重明、灵山失道、佛运大跌之事，早已传遍三界六道、九天十地。
玉帝早知始末，静坐九龙帝座，神色肃穆、天威深沉。
殿下文武仙卿、诸天星宿、雷部正神、四大天师、南北二斗、五岳帝君、四海龙王尽皆肃立。
此前天兵倒戈、大义救正，诸天仙将早已心知是非曲直，此刻见四君登天而来，人人心生敬重、个个静待公道宣判。
殿外仙官高声传报：
“启禀玉帝！苍生四君，登庭谒天！叩见凌霄！”
玉帝闻言，龙目开明、天声浩荡：“宣！”
一声宣旨，响彻九霄！
四君稳步踏入凌霄宝殿，衣袂无尘、道骨浩然、正气凛然、不卑不亢。
四人立于殿中正中，面对三界共主、诸天至尊，从容躬身行礼，行天道君臣大礼，不跪凡尘、独敬诸天。
“苍生四君，叩见玉帝陛下！”
玉帝端坐帝座，垂眸俯视，声含天规、自带权衡：
“四君守道万古、护佑苍生、安定地脉、调和阴阳，功德遍及三界、恩泽流布万古。
此前蒙冤灵山、遭囚幽狱、被污逆名、身受酷刑，朕尽知始末、尽察因果、尽明是非。

今日尔等登庭入殿，可是有冤欲诉、有状欲呈？”
宁洋北立身向前，气度端方、言辞朗朗，字字入天规、句句证大道：

Chapter 80: The four kings came to court to express their grievances, and the Jade Emperor sealed the heavens.
In Chang'an of the Tang Dynasty, the sky was bright and auspicious.
Since the jade plate of the common people broke away from the confinement of Buddhism, broke through the void and returned eastward, and recognized its master and returned to the clan, the energy structure of the three realms was completely overturned.
The Buddha's luck in Xitu Lingshan collapsed, the golden light faded, the golden lotus withered, and the Zen sound faded;
In the Eastern Land, the right path in the world is clear, the mountains and rivers are clear, the epidemics and poisons are eradicated, and all the people return to their hearts.
An eternal game between immortals and Buddhas, disputes over treasures, and the tug-of-war between good and evil ended with the defeat of Lingshan, false dreams becoming empty, and the restoration of the right path.
The four monarchs stand in the sea of ​​clouds in the imperial city, with the jade disk above their heads spinning in clear light, and the Taoist charm of the people around them is perfect. The foundation of the Tao is repaired, the origin is restored, obsessions are clarified, and the whole body is filled with merit.
Ning Yangbei raised his eyes and looked in the direction of the Thirty-Three Heavens Lingxiao Palace, and said in a calm voice: "Lingshan defies heaven and chaos, seizes treasures and imprisons gods, frames loyal people, brings disaster to the common people, deceives the heaven and the earth, and secretly changes the destiny. There are numerous evidence of crimes and huge karmic debts.
In the past, we were wronged and trapped, fell into the hands of others, found it difficult to redress, and found it difficult to redress our grievances;
Now the supreme treasure has returned to the sect, the righteous path has been restored, people's hearts have been righteous, and the way of heaven has become clear.
It is the time to go to court to complain, to appeal to the heavens, to sue Lingshan, and to ask for punishment from heaven! "
Zhang Zhongdong said sternly: "The false Buddha has been planning for thousands of years, using his power to conspire to disrupt the way of heaven, using his tyranny to steal the common people, using compassion to cover up evil intentions, and using holy coercion to suppress justice.
If the heavens do not file a case this time, judge him in the heavenly court, determine his crime, and clarify his fault,
Then the way of heaven is unorganized, the rules of heaven are useless, there is no distinction between good and evil, and it will be difficult to rectify it forever! "
Wang Xuenan cupped his hands and said: "The four of us are not fighting for honor and disgrace out of personal grudges, but only seeking public rights for the way of heaven!
Don’t ask for killings from heaven, don’t ask for the destruction of Lingshan Mountain in the three realms,
We only want the guilty to be convicted, the wronged to be avenged, the disobedient to be punished, and the righteous to be sealed.
Let everyone in the three worlds know: The way of heaven is orderly, justice will not perish, those who go against the way will be punished, and those who keep the way will prosper! "
Chen Xue's western sword intent was concentrated in his eyes, and his voice was like gold and stone: "Today I am in court, one is to redress the eternal grievances, the other is to present Buddhism's serious crimes, the third is to restore the orthodoxy of the common people, and the fourth is to determine the future pattern of the Three Realms!"
The minds of the four monarchs are united, the rhyme of the Tao is the same, and the righteousness is soaring to the sky.
Now I bid farewell to Emperor Taizong of the Tang Dynasty and his ministers.
Li Shimin led hundreds of civil and military officials to stand in Danbi, bowed their hands and respectfully said to each other:
"The four saintly kings are going to heaven to redress their grievances, and they will definitely make heaven's way clear and the righteousness last forever!
I, together with all the people of the Tang Dynasty, are waiting for the justice of the heavens and the honor of the Holy King! "
The Four Lords nodded slightly, stepped on the auspicious clouds, and took up the long wind. Four majestic shadows shot straight into the sky, passing through the sea of clouds, breaking through the wind, passing through the Star Tower, and reaching outside the Thirty-Three Heavens Lingxiao Palace.
At that time, there were already thousands of visions in heaven, and the heavens were shaking.
The story of the return of the jade plate to the sect, the revival of the righteous path, the loss of the path of Lingshan, and the great decline of the Buddha's luck have already spread throughout the three realms, six realms, nine heavens and ten earths.
The Jade Emperor knew the whole story and sat quietly on the Nine Dragons throne with a solemn and majestic look on his face.
Your Highness, the Immortal Minister Wenwu, the Stars of the Heavens, the God of Thunder, the Four Heavenly Masters, the North and South Dou, the Emperors of the Five Sacred Mountains, and the Dragon Kings of the Four Seas all stand in awe.
Before, the heavenly soldiers turned against each other and the righteous people saved justice, and all the heavenly and immortal generals already knew the right and wrong. Now that they see the four kings ascending to the sky, everyone respects them and waits for the justice to be pronounced.
The immortal official outside the palace loudly announced:
"Report to the Jade Emperor! The four kings of the common people, come to the court to pay homage to the sky! Kowtow to the sky!"
When the Jade Emperor heard this, his eyes were opened and the voice from the sky was loud: "Xuan!"
A decree resounded throughout the sky!
The four monarchs steadily stepped into the Lingxiao Palace, their clothes were dust-free, their moral integrity was awe-inspiring, their righteousness was awe-inspiring, and they were neither humble nor arrogant.
The four people stood in the middle of the hall, facing the co-lord of the three realms and the supreme being of the heavens. They bowed calmly and saluted, performing the great courtesy of the kings and ministers of heaven. They did not kneel to the mortal world and only respected the heavens.
"The four kings of the common people, pay homage to His Majesty the Jade Emperor!"
The Jade Emperor was sitting on his throne, looking down with lowered eyes, and his voice contained heavenly rules and weighed in:
“The Four Lords have guarded the Tao for eternity, protected the common people, stabilized the earth’s veins, and reconciled Yin and Yang. Their merits have spread throughout the three realms, and their benevolence has spread throughout eternity.
I have been wronged before, imprisoned in hell, defamed, and tortured. I know the whole story, observe cause and effect, and understand right and wrong.
Today you come to the court and enter the palace, but you have a grievance that you want to complain about.Have something to report? "
Ning Yangbei stood forward, with a dignified demeanor and clear words. Every word was in accordance with the rules of heaven, and every sentence was a testament to the great truth:
"Your Majesty, Holy Ming!
The four of us ascended to the sky today to pay homage to the Jade Emperor and enter the heavenly court, not to complain about personal grievances or avenge ourselves.
